title: Frontend Developer (React)
text:
Frontend Developer (React) - Sample Commerce Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad
Experience: 1 to 4 years

Role
- Build pages for our shopping app in React with TypeScript
- Turn designs into responsive HTML and CSS
- Call REST APIs and manage state with Redux
- Write tests with Jest

Skills we need
- JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript
- React
- HTML5, CSS3
- Redux
- Jest

Good to have
- Next.js
- Accessibility (WCAG)
- Storybook

Notice period: up to 60 days. Work from office in Madhapur.
